v.title: Pochettino’s Chaos: A Nightmarish Start at United
v.excerpt: Pochettino’s chaotic week ends in a historic 1‑0 loss to Chelsea, 2‑1 to Arsenal and 2‑0 to Liverpool – the worst start ever for a United manager.
v.body:
## Quick take
Mauricio Pochettino’s first week at Manchester United has been a chaotic disaster, with a 1‑0 loss to Chelsea, a 2‑1 defeat to Arsenal and a 2‑0 loss to Liverpool. The new manager’s debut is the worst start in the club’s history.

## What happened
Pochettino’s debut came on a rainy Tuesday against Chelsea. The Reds were 0‑0 after 90 minutes, but a late header from Christian Pulisic gave the hosts a 1‑0 win. The next day, United faced Arsenal at the Emirates. Pochettino’s side looked disorganised; a defensive lapse cost them a goal, and Arsenal’s Gabriel Jesus netted the winner.

On the weekend, United travelled to Anfield where Liverpool’s dominance was on full display. Pochettino’s men failed to contain Jordan Henderson and were beaten 2‑0. The cumulative effect of three heavy defeats has left United’s fans and the board questioning the new manager’s fit.

## Why it matters
- **Club morale**: The early exit from the Premier League and a shaky start to the Champions League could dent United’s confidence, a vital factor when competing against Barcelona’s own title‑chasing squad.
- **Tactical identity**: Pochettino’s emphasis on high‑pressing and quick transitions is yet to translate into results. Barcelona’s tactical flexibility may prove a useful benchmark for a manager looking to rebuild.
- **Transfer window implications**: A poor start may pressure United to accelerate signings. Barcelona’s recent acquisitions could provide a model for a swift, strategic overhaul.

## What's next
Watch how Pochettino reacts in the next match against Everton. A win will be essential to stop the spiral and restore belief. The tactical adjustments he makes—whether a deeper defensive line or a more aggressive pressing game—will reveal whether he can reverse the chaotic start and re‑establish United as a title contender.

*Source: [Chaotic week, nightmare start and huge reality check for Pochettino](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwd012903kvgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
